description: React 19 multimodal composer — three independent inputs (text, image drop, audio record) packed into one multipart POST to /api/multimodal.

buildHints.whenToUse: Multimodal LLM clients that accept text, image, and audio in one request — GPT-4o, Claude Vision, or Gemini multimodal.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` then `pnpm dev` — the three-panel composer loads on port 4182.
Wire the backend: implement POST /api/multimodal that accepts multipart/form-data with fields `text`, `image`, and `audio`. See api/README.md for provider recipes (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini).
The client handles both non-streamed JSON `{"reply":"..."}` and streamed text/plain — pick whichever the backend returns.
Run `node validate-multimodal.mjs` to verify the scaffold wiring before adding features.
gotchas: multipart/form-data is the only format all three big multimodal APIs accept without re-encoding. Don't wrap image + audio in a JSON body — base64 overhead bloats payloads and breaks streaming.
React 19 Strict Mode runs effects twice in dev — getUserMedia without a cleanup track-stop causes NotReadableError on the second invocation. The cleanup is already wired; don't remove it.
Dropped files trigger both `dragover` and `drop` — preventDefault on dragover is MANDATORY or the browser navigates to the file URL and the drop handler never fires.
Safari's DataTransferItemList only exposes files synchronously inside the drop handler. Awaiting anything before reading `e.dataTransfer.files` clears the list.
The <audio> preview element needs `URL.revokeObjectURL` on re-record or remove — Chrome retains the blob until full GC otherwise.
architectureNotes: Three independent useState machines (text, image, audio) converge only at send() — this prevents stale-closure bugs that arise from a single merged state object.
Streaming is plain Fetch API ReadableStream + TextDecoder — no SSE or WebSocket dependency required.

placeholders.description: {{headline}} and {{subheadline}} are template tokens replaced at compose time by the family defaults. The POST target /api/multimodal is the fixed contract — implement that route in your backend.
